scripts.command: Write-Output '[START] CTID simulation T1018'; $simulationRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'Morgana\CTID'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $simulationRoot -Force | Out-Null; $artifactPath = Join-Path $simulationRoot 'CTID-001-t1018.txt'; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,LastBootUpTime; Get-Process | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Id,Path; Get-NetIPConfiguration -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,IPv4Address; Write-Output '[SUCCESS] CTID simulation T1018 family=discovery';
